n4f1687e34a.headline: Italian firms gloomier on outlook amid trade war fears, central bank survey shows
n4f1687e34a.summary: Pessimism about the economic outlook has increased among Italian businesses as concerns about an international trade war weigh on sentiment, the Bank of Italy said.
n4f1687e34a.why: Business sentiment surveys from the Bank of Italy give early signals on investment and output in the euro area's third-largest economy.

n3c4c723ea3.headline: Peru's niche Bretaña crude oil gains popularity in US
n3c4c723ea3.summary: Peru's niche Bretaña crude is gaining popularity in the United States, with a first cargo discharging on the US Gulf Coast this month as refiners seek alternatives.
n3c4c723ea3.why: Crude grade differences affect refinery margins, since refiners choose among grades based on quality, price and supply availability.

ncc9e451d0b.headline: Robert Walters cuts more jobs amid troubles in hiring market
ncc9e451d0b.summary: Robert Walters is cutting more jobs amid troubles in the hiring market and told investors it no longer expected to make a profit for the year.
ncc9e451d0b.why: Robert Walters is a recruitment firm, and its results indicate conditions in white-collar hiring markets.

ndb8c6f8d05.headline: Colombian peso shows outstanding resistance of the (COP) in Latin America
ndb8c6f8d05.summary: The Colombian peso has shown notable resistance in Latin America, defying downward pressures. The report does not detail specific drivers.
ndb8c6f8d05.why: The peso's moves affect Colombian import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in local assets.

impacts.name: Colombian peso
impacts.why: The report describes the peso as resisting downward pressure, implying relative strength.

n1ed3fda42b.headline: Canalys: Apple leads the way in global Q4 smartphone shipments
n1ed3fda42b.summary: Global smartphone shipments grew 7% year on year to an estimated 330 million units in Q4 2024, with Apple leading all brands, according to Canalys.
n1ed3fda42b.why: Apple designs the iPhone and is one of the world's largest smartphone vendors, so its share of quarterly shipments is closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Apple is the top-ranked brand by Q4 2024 smartphone shipments, per the Canalys data.

n88f572f833.headline: Estonia Choosing Site for Nuclear Power Plant With GE Hitachi Reactors
n88f572f833.summary: Fermi Energia has started selecting a site for Estonia's first nuclear power plant, more than a decade after government officials initially approved construction.
n88f572f833.why: Nuclear projects involve large multi-year capital commitments, and reactor vendors such as GE Hitachi are central to who wins such contracts.

nfd9199edfc.headline: Spain plans new 100 per cent tax for homes bought by UK and non-EU residents
nfd9199edfc.summary: Spain plans a 100 per cent tax on homes bought by non-EU residents, including those from the UK, according to the report.
nfd9199edfc.why: Foreign buyers are a meaningful part of Spain's property market, so tax changes affect housing prices and real estate investment.

n7982a5230b.headline: Road Tolls Will Be Brought Back –Ato Forson
n7982a5230b.summary: Finance Minister-designate Cassiel Ato Baah Forson said the government of President John Dramani Mahama would reintroduce road tolls to raise revenue. The NDC has long held that position.
n7982a5230b.why: Revenue measures such as road tolls affect Ghana's fiscal position, which matters for its sovereign debt and currency outlook.

na27ae8ee82.headline: Nikkei down as US inflation data awaited
na27ae8ee82.summary: Japan's Nikkei fell 1.8 per cent and touched a six-week low as investors shed chip stocks. Traders were awaiting US inflation data.
na27ae8ee82.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward export and technology companies sensitive to global demand.
na27ae8ee82.why_moved: Investors shed chip stocks and grew cautious ahead of the US inflation data release.

nab49e8517f.headline: Amadeus to pay €0.50/share dividend on 17 January, 14% higher than same dividend in 2023
nab49e8517f.summary: Amadeus will pay an interim dividend of €0.50 per share on 17 January, 14% higher than the same dividend in 2023. The payment relates to 2024 results.
nab49e8517f.why: Amadeus is a Madrid-based travel technology company whose distributions to shareholders depend on its earnings and cash flow.

n0decef9bea.headline: Knights reports profit surge as recruitment and acquisitions drive growth | TheBusinessDesk.com
n0decef9bea.summary: Knights reported a profit surge driven by recruitment and acquisitions. Its headcount has grown from 430 to 1,335 staff since its 2018 IPO.
n0decef9bea.why: Knights is a UK professional services group, and its results reflect demand for specialist staffing and advisory work.

na0e45d0076.headline: Spain plans new 100 per cent tax for homes bought by UK and non-EU residents
na0e45d0076.summary: Spain plans a 100 per cent tax on homes bought by non-EU residents, including those from the UK. The measure would apply to property purchases in Spain.
na0e45d0076.why: Foreign buyers are an important part of Spain's property market, so tax changes affect housing demand and prices.

nbb12808fe2.headline: Head of International Court of Justice named Lebanon’s new prime minister
nbb12808fe2.summary: New Lebanese president Joseph Aoun has asked the head of the International Court of Justice to form the country's new government. The move follows Aoun's election as president.
nbb12808fe2.why: Lebanon is a heavily indebted state whose government formation shapes its prospects for IMF-linked reforms and financial recovery. Political stability is a key factor for its banking sector and bonds.

n0fd8f0746a.headline: How climate change is reshaping home insurance in California — and the rest of the U.S.
n0fd8f0746a.summary: Worsening wildfires are raising home insurance rates in California, the biggest US insurance market by premiums. Other states are also feeling pressure as climate disasters increase across the country.
n0fd8f0746a.why: Home insurers price risk based on disaster exposure, and rising premiums affect housing affordability and insurer profitability. California's market is the largest in the US, so changes there matter for the sector.

nba8627d9ee.headline: S&W Seed stock sprouts as board explores sale, merger options
nba8627d9ee.summary: S&W Seed's stock rose more than 30% on Tuesday after the company said it is exploring options that include selling the business or merging with another entity.
nba8627d9ee.why: S&W Seed is a US agricultural seed company. Board-level sale or merger reviews often lead to takeover premiums or deal announcements that reprice small-cap stocks.
nba8627d9ee.why_moved: The company said its board is exploring selling the business or merging with another entity, and the stock jumped more than 30% on that news.

nca1cade2d6.headline: Head of International Court of Justice named Lebanon’s new prime minister
nca1cade2d6.summary: New president Joseph Aoun has asked the head of the International Court of Justice to form Lebanon's new government.
nca1cade2d6.why: Government formation in Lebanon affects reform commitments, IMF-related negotiations and investor confidence in a highly indebted economy.

n5b8fb8783d.headline: Fitch Rates Deere's Proposed Senior Unsecured Notes 'A+'
n5b8fb8783d.summary: Fitch Ratings has assigned an A+ rating to Deere & Company's planned issuance of senior unsecured notes. Proceeds will be available for general corporate purposes.
n5b8fb8783d.why: Deere is a US agricultural and construction equipment maker, and its credit ratings affect its borrowing costs. Fitch ratings are a key input for bond investors.

impacts.name: Deere & Company
impacts.why: The A+ rating applies to Deere's planned notes issuance.

n435f84a0d2.headline: Manchester-based Intelligent Lending acquires TotallyMoney
n435f84a0d2.summary: Manchester-based Intelligent Lending has acquired TotallyMoney, a free finance app owned by Ocean Finance. The deal brings the app under Intelligent Lending's ownership.
n435f84a0d2.why: Intelligent Lending is a UK specialist lender, and consolidation in the UK personal finance market reshapes competition among lenders and comparison services. Acquisitions of this kind are routine in the sector.

n5ec13df24c.headline: Gaza ceasefire deal hopes lift region's government bond markets
n5ec13df24c.summary: Hopes of a ceasefire deal to end the Gaza war lifted the region's government bond markets and Israel's shekel on Tuesday. Investors sensed relief after 15 months of conflict.
n5ec13df24c.why: Israel's government bonds and the shekel are sensitive to security risk, so changes in conflict expectations feed directly into their pricing.
n5ec13df24c.why_moved: Investors reacted to hopes of a ceasefire ending the Gaza war, which reduced perceived regional risk. The input reports bonds and the shekel both gained on the news.

nd2111d3696.headline: ‘The million-dollar question:’ Trump’s populist economic promises meet Republican skepticism
nd2111d3696.summary: Trump's populist economic promises meet skepticism from Republicans, with tax ideas aimed at workers. Higher corporate taxes would be a tough sell in the Republican-led Congress, according to the report.
nd2111d3696.why: US tax and fiscal policy shapes corporate earnings, government borrowing and Treasury yields, so the prospects for legislation matter to investors.

n54aaf8b258.headline: Mexico’s President Rolls out Plan Aimed at Curbing Chinese Imports
n54aaf8b258.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum rolled out a plan aimed at curbing Chinese imports and defended the US-Mexico-Canada trade pact, due for review in 2026.
n54aaf8b258.why: Mexico is a major manufacturing exporter and trading partner of the US, so import restrictions and USMCA review timing affect cross-border supply chains.

nd0c1d4ab79.headline: NATO Baltic leaders seek to boost security after cable 'sabotage' - World News
nd0c1d4ab79.summary: NATO countries on the Baltic Sea met in Helsinki to boost security following suspected sabotage of undersea cables, which is widely blamed on Russia. The meeting followed the suspected damage.
nd0c1d4ab79.why: Undersea cables carry most international data and telecom traffic, so their disruption affects telecom operators and critical infrastructure investors.

nbd654cd1c6.headline: Crude prices supported by sanctions, but demand uncertainties weigh on market
nbd654cd1c6.summary: Crude oil prices are being supported by new U.S. sanctions on Russian oil exports, while demand uncertainties weigh on the market. Market updates focus on the potential impact of the sanctions.
nbd654cd1c6.why: Brent is the main international crude benchmark, and sanctions on Russian exports can tighten global supply.
nbd654cd1c6.why_moved: New U.S. sanctions on Russian oil exports are supporting crude prices, although demand uncertainties are weighing on the market.

n2cfdbc1731.headline: Dollar rises on strong labour data, focus shifts to Fed speeches and inflation data
n2cfdbc1731.summary: The dollar rose after strong labour data, with traders turning their attention to Federal Reserve speeches and upcoming inflation data.
n2cfdbc1731.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, so its moves affect global bond yields, commodity prices and emerging-market flows.

n16f2f0a6af.headline: Vietnam and Russia sign agreement to expand co-operation on nuclear energy
n16f2f0a6af.summary: Russia's Rosatom and Vietnam's EVN signed an agreement to expand nuclear energy cooperation during a two-day visit to Hanoi by Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin.
n16f2f0a6af.why: Rosatom is Russia's state nuclear corporation and a major exporter of nuclear reactors and fuel, so its deals shape global nuclear power supply.

n24fc2f33c7.headline: TikTok calls report of possible sale to billionaire Elon Musk's X 'pure fiction'
n24fc2f33c7.summary: TikTok rejected a report that Elon Musk's X would buy the video-sharing platform from its Chinese owner ByteDance, calling it 'pure fiction'.
n24fc2f33c7.why: TikTok is owned by Beijing-based ByteDance, and any change in its ownership would have major implications for the global social media and advertising market.

n1bf1b3d264.headline: Germany far right AfD embraces mass deportation of migrants as election nears
n1bf1b3d264.summary: Germany's far-right AfD, holding a conference in Riesa, Saxony, laid out ambitions to close borders, resume buying Russian gas and dismantle the EU, German media reported.
n1bf1b3d264.why: Alternative für Deutschland is a German political party, and its energy and EU policies could influence Germany's energy supply and trade ties.

nfae14f7bf7.headline: Sri Lanka’s Siyambaladuwa 100MW solar farm awaiting bankable lands
nfae14f7bf7.summary: A proposal to give bankable land rights to a company building a 100 MW solar park in Siyambalanduwa is awaiting Treasury observations, Power Minister Kumara Jayakody said.
nfae14f7bf7.why: Utility-scale solar projects depend on secured land rights and financing, which affects project timelines and investment.

n47603b027d.headline: Samsung Takes Top Spot in U.S. Patents for Third Year Running While TSMC Rises Into Second Place; After Four-Year Falloff, Grants Increase Nearly 4% | Newswise
n47603b027d.summary: Samsung kept the top position in U.S. patent grants for a third straight year, while TSMC moved into second place. U.S. grants rose nearly 4% after four years of decline, according to IFI CLAIMS rankings.
n47603b027d.why: Samsung Electronics is a South Korean technology conglomerate and a major memory chip and smartphone maker. Patent activity is a gauge of R&D intensity and competitive positioning in semiconductors.

nc8c5941cf8.headline: Consumers warned they will ‘feel the pain’ as the 'economic situation looks increasingly dire'
nc8c5941cf8.summary: Consumers have been warned they will feel the pain as the economic situation looks increasingly dire. The weakening pound could lead to price hikes across various sectors.
nc8c5941cf8.why: Sterling's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the spending power of UK households and businesses.

n851947cafb.headline: One in 10 Canadians live in places susceptible to green transition disruption: report
n851947cafb.summary: A new report finds one in 10 Canadians live in communities susceptible to workforce disruption from the transition to a greener economy. It also outlines solutions to help regions adapt.
n851947cafb.why: Energy transition labour impacts shape regional employment, public policy spending and sector investment in Canada.

n5df1220d27.headline: World Bank pledges support for Pakistan’s development
n5df1220d27.summary: The World Bank has committed $20 billion to Pakistan, with 19 of its 24 directors voting in favour of the decision. The pledge supports Pakistan's development.
n5df1220d27.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose financing supports government budgets, infrastructure and reform programmes in developing economies.

na44e2dbd2b.headline: Akelius divests shares in Castellum to the parent company
na44e2dbd2b.summary: Akelius Residential Property is selling its remaining holding in Castellum to its parent company, Akelius Apartments Limited, according to a press release. The stake is just over 51.8 million shares.
na44e2dbd2b.why: Castellum is a Swedish listed property company, and Akelius is a major residential landlord whose holdings change the ownership structure of listed real estate.

n20177d090d.headline: Thailand's Thaksin bullish on legalising online gambling, crypto
n20177d090d.summary: Former Thai leader Thaksin Shinawatra believes Thailand should push to legalise online gambling and crypto, arguing it could net the government substantial revenue.
n20177d090d.why: Thailand is Southeast Asia's second-largest economy, and any legalisation of gambling or crypto would be a significant regulatory shift for the sector.

n110d3c393a.headline: Stock market today: Most of Wall Street rises following encouraging inflation data, but Lilly drags
n110d3c393a.summary: Most U.S. stocks rose after an encouraging inflation update, but a drop in Eli Lilly and other influential stocks kept the indexes in check. The S&P 500 edged up.
n110d3c393a.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of large U.S. companies, and inflation data shapes expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate policy.

impacts.name: Eli Lilly
impacts.why: Shares of Eli Lilly fell on the day, according to the report.

n110d3c393a.why_moved: Inflation data came in encouragingly, lifting most U.S. stocks, while a drop in Eli Lilly and other influential names held the indexes back.

n607bfd56ed.headline: US targets CNOOC JV in expanding sanctions on Russia
n607bfd56ed.summary: The US expanded sanctions on Russia, targeting Chinese energy companies linked to Russian crude exports. Shandong United Energy Pipeline Transportation is accused of materially supporting sanctioned Russian entities.
n607bfd56ed.why: CNOOC is China's state-controlled offshore oil producer, and sanctions on linked energy firms can disrupt trade flows and payments for Russian crude.

nbef03c6ebc.headline: Roc Oil controls over 96 percent in Tethys Oil, calls for compulsory acquisition
nbef03c6ebc.summary: Bidder Roc Oil controls about 96.19 percent of Tethys Oil shares after the extended acceptance period ended. Roc Oil is calling for compulsory acquisition of the remaining shares.
nbef03c6ebc.why: Tethys Oil is a Swedish-listed oil and gas company, and a compulsory acquisition lets a majority holder buy out minority shareholders and delist the company.

nc54262f69b.headline: BB arming itself with new law to manage bank ownership transfer, stem future legal tangles
nc54262f69b.summary: Bangladesh Bank is arming itself with a new law to manage bank ownership transfers and prevent future legal disputes. The government is also drafting another law to safeguard depositors' interests.
nc54262f69b.why: Bank ownership rules and depositor protection shape confidence in the banking system and the investment risk of lenders operating in the country.

ne5e75e930d.headline: Deutsche Wohnen To Sell P&W Nursing Firm To Hamburg Municipal Holding HGV For EUR 380 Mln
ne5e75e930d.summary: Deutsche Wohnen, part of Vonovia, agreed to sell nursing company PFLEGEN & WOHNEN HAMBURG to Hamburg Municipal Holding Company HGV for EUR 380 million, according to the announcement.
ne5e75e930d.why: Vonovia is one of Germany's largest residential property companies, and Deutsche Wohnen is one of its subsidiaries.

nf2a4a09e83.headline: Delays, Trudeau resignation threaten Toronto-Quebec City high-frequency rail project
nf2a4a09e83.summary: Delays and Trudeau's resignation threaten the Toronto-Quebec City high-frequency rail project. The corridor would run mostly on new track on land largely owned by Canada's two major railways.
nf2a4a09e83.why: Large rail infrastructure projects depend on government funding and approvals, and they affect freight and passenger firms such as Canada's two major railways.

n22cef4ce44.headline: Mitsubishi Electric Signs MoU with AWS
n22cef4ce44.summary: Mitsubishi Electric aims to leverage cloud computing and AI to help cut data center carbon emissions.
n22cef4ce44.why: Partnerships in green technology impact data center operations and energy efficiency investments.

n7f467fa1e1.headline: Slightly Tamer-Than-Expected Inflation Data May Lead To Strength On Wall Street
n7f467fa1e1.summary: Major U.S. indices are projected to open higher following slightly tamer inflation data, signaling potential market optimism.
n7f467fa1e1.why: U.S. market sentiment and inflation data influence investor positioning and monetary policy expectations.

n2732b66bee.headline: Goyal: Signing FTAs only after consultations with stakeholders
n2732b66bee.summary: India's commerce minister Piyush Goyal announced that free trade agreements are being finalized after extensive stakeholder consultations.
n2732b66bee.why: New FTAs could influence trade flows, tariffs, and economic growth, impacting domestic and international markets.

n6ab43b8c27.headline: Startup India: Catalysing economic growth and innovation
n6ab43b8c27.summary: India's entrepreneurial landscape has transformed over the last decade, with cities like Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Delhi-NCR becoming hubs of innovation and startup activity.
n6ab43b8c27.why: Startup ecosystems drive job creation, innovation, and economic diversification, impacting India's growth trajectory and investment climate.
